newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not established, USDA said. Buyer inquiry was only fair. Seller interest light at present bids of $102.00 to occasionally $103.00 per cwt on a dressed basis and on mostly Choice and "clean". Many cattle priced around $104.00.
Most recent established market 103.00-103.50 last Friday.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Heifers - Two loads Select and Choice 2-3 1100
For week - 2,600 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 6,300 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 1,000
